# Game testing

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-compatibility-docs.mjs. Edit data/game-compatibility.json. -->

As of **12 November 2026**, ScummWEB has checked 286 editions across
270 games.

| Startup result | Editions |
| --- | ---: |
| Verified | 277 |
| With warnings | 9 |
| Failed | 0 |

Startup checks cover a screen, menu, original prompt, or opening scene.
Warnings and failures describe ScummVM or ScummWEB issues. Results apply
to the tested edition and cover startup only.

Search [Game compatibility](https://scummweb.tsilva.eu/compatibility) for
editions, observations, and earlier checks. The
[repository data](../data/game-compatibility.json) preserves the full
records and lists 384 games without a recorded check.
Their upstream ratings come from the
[ScummVM 2026.4.0 compatibility chart](https://www.scummvm.org/compatibility/2026.4.0/).
See [how to record a result](maintaining-scummweb.md#maintaining-game-compatibility).
